storyCards.headline: Rain: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Dragon's "Rain" reached #88 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Rain" is a song by New Zealand rock group Dragon released in July 1983 as the first single ahead of their seventh studio album, Body and the Beat (June 1984).

The song peaked at #88 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 4 weeks on the chart.

Rain was released in 1984.
